```{r cars}
# =========================
# Differential Expression from two CSVs (genes x samples)
# Requires: limma, ggplot2, pheatmap, data.table
# install.packages(c("limma", "ggplot2", "pheatmap", "data.table"))
# =========================

# --- user inputs ---
healthy_csv <- "foranalysis_combined_female_df_pdac.csv"   # genes in rows, samples in columns
disease_csv <- "foranalysis_combined_male_df_pdac.csv"   # genes in rows, samples in columns
out_prefix  <- "DE_results"    # prefix for outputs

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(limma)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(data.table)
})

# ---- read & align ----
read_expr <- function(path) {
  # Accepts CSV with gene IDs either as first column or as row names
  dt <- fread(path)
  # If first column looks like gene IDs (non-numeric), make it rownames
  if (!is.numeric(dt[[1]])) {
    rn <- dt[[1]]
    dt[, 1 := NULL]
    mat <- as.matrix(dt)
    rownames(mat) <- rn
  } else {
    mat <- as.matrix(dt)
    # if no explicit gene column, assume rownames already present after fread? If not, make generic
    if (is.null(rownames(mat))) rownames(mat) <- paste0("gene_", seq_len(nrow(mat)))
  }
  storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  mat
}

mat_healthy <- read_expr(healthy_csv)
mat_disease <- read_expr(disease_csv)

print(dim(mat_healthy))
print(dim(mat_disease))

# Intersect genes and bind
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(mat_healthy), rownames(mat_disease))
if (length(common_genes) < 10) stop("Too few overlapping genes between files.")
mat_healthy <- mat_healthy[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
mat_disease <- mat_disease[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]

expr <- cbind(mat_healthy, mat_disease)
group <- factor(c(rep("Female", ncol(mat_healthy)), rep("Male", ncol(mat_disease))),
                levels = c("Female", "Male"))
colnames(expr) <- make.unique(colnames(expr), sep = "_")

# Optional log2 transform if values look like raw counts/intense
q99 <- as.numeric(quantile(expr, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))
if (q99 > 100) {
  message("Applying log2(x+1) transform based on value magnitude...")
  expr <- log2(expr + 1)
}

# Remove rows with too many NAs or zero variance
expr <- expr[rowSums(is.finite(expr)) >= ncol(expr) * 0.8, , drop = FALSE]
v <- apply(expr, 1, stats::var, na.rm = TRUE)
expr <- expr[v > 0, , drop = FALSE]

# ---- limma differential expression ----
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)                 # no intercept
colnames(design) <- levels(group)                   # "Female","Male"

fit <- lmFit(expr, design)
cont <- makeContrasts(Male_vs_Female = Male - Female, levels = design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2, robust = TRUE, trend = TRUE)

res <- topTable(fit2, coef = "Male_vs_Female", number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
res$Gene <- rownames(res)
# Positive logFC => higher in Male; negative => higher in Female
res <- res[, c("Gene","logFC","AveExpr","t","P.Value","adj.P.Val","B")]

# Save results
out_csv <- paste0(out_prefix, "_table_gender.csv")
fwrite(res, out_csv)
message("Results written to: ", out_csv)
```

```{r}
# ---- Volcano plot (with colored thresholds, counts, and top-20 labels) ----
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggrepel))
fc_thresh  <- 0.25
fdr_thresh <- 0.05

res$neglog10P <- -log10(res$P.Value)
res$status <- "NS"
res$status[res$adj.P.Val < fdr_thresh & res$logFC >=  fc_thresh] <- "Up"
res$status[res$adj.P.Val < fdr_thresh & res$logFC <= -fc_thresh] <- "Down"
res$status <- factor(res$status, levels = c("Down","NS","Up"))

# shape mapping: TRUE = triangle, FALSE = circle
res$is_sig <- with(res, adj.P.Val < fdr_thresh & abs(logFC) >= fc_thresh)

up_n   <- sum(res$status == "Up", na.rm = TRUE)
down_n <- sum(res$status == "Down", na.rm = TRUE)

top_label_n <- min(20, nrow(res))
lab_df <- res[order(res$adj.P.Val), ][seq_len(top_label_n), ]

x_min <- min(res$logFC, na.rm = TRUE); x_max <- max(res$logFC, na.rm = TRUE)
y_max <- max(res$neglog10P, na.rm = TRUE); x_span <- x_max - x_min

volcano <- ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = neglog10P)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_thresh), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -fc_thresh, color = "steelblue3", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept =  fc_thresh, color = "red3",       linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(color = status, shape = is_sig), alpha = 0.85, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Down = "steelblue3", NS = "grey70", Up = "red3")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 17), labels = c("Not sig", "Significant")) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = lab_df, aes(label = Gene),
    size = 3, max.overlaps = 200, min.segment.length = 0,
    box.padding = 0.3, point.padding = 0.2
  ) +
  annotate("text",
    x = x_min + 0.02 * x_span, y = y_max * 0.98,
    label = paste0("Up (FC ≥ ", fc_thresh, ", FDR < ", fdr_thresh, "): ", up_n),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, color = "red3", fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  annotate("text",
    x = x_min + 0.02 * x_span, y = y_max * 0.92,
    label = paste0("Down (FC ≤ -", fc_thresh, ", FDR < ", fdr_thresh, "): ", down_n),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, color = "steelblue3", fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Volcano plot: female vs male",
       x = "log2 Fold Change",
       y = expression(-log[10](P))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "top",
        aspect.ratio = 1) +                     # square panel
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

ggsave(paste0(out_prefix, "_volcano_gender.png"), volcano, width = 5.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)  # square file
```

```{r}
# ---- PCA + boxplots + PERMANOVA (pipe-free) ----
# Needs: ggplot2, ggrepel, patchwork, RColorBrewer, vegan, multcompView

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2); library(ggrepel); library(patchwork)
  library(RColorBrewer); library(vegan); library(multcompView)
})

# 1) top 20 genes by FDR
top_n <- 20
top_genes <- head(res$Gene[order(res$adj.P.Val)], n = min(top_n, nrow(res)))

# 2) PCA on samples using top genes
pca <- prcomp(t(expr[top_genes, , drop = FALSE]), scale. = TRUE)
pve <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)

# 3) sample metadata
pcoadata <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(expr),
  PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca$x[, 2]
)
pcoadata$Subtype <- factor(as.character(group),
                           levels = c("Female", "Male"),
                           labels = c("Female", "Male"))

# palette (2 groups)
pal2 <- setNames(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(2),
                 c("Female", "Male"))

# ---- main PCA scatter ----
plot <- ggplot(pcoadata, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = Subtype, fill = Subtype), size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal2) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("(PC1: ", round(pve[1] * 100, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("(PC2: ", round(pve[2] * 100, 2), "%)")
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12, margin = margin(t = 5), face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12, margin = margin(r = 5), face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 9, face = "bold"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = "black"),
    legend.position = c(0.001, 0.999),
    legend.justification = c(0.0001, 1),
    aspect.ratio = 1  # square panel
  )

# ---- CLD letters for PC1/PC2 ----
fit1 <- aov(PC1 ~ Subtype, data = pcoadata)
cld1 <- multcompLetters4(fit1, TukeyHSD(fit1))
dt1 <- aggregate(PC1 ~ Subtype, data = pcoadata, FUN = max)
names(dt1)[2] <- "value_max"
dt1$sd <- aggregate(PC1 ~ Subtype, data = pcoadata, FUN = sd)$PC1
text1 <- merge(
  transform(as.data.frame.list(cld1$Subtype), Subtype = rownames(as.data.frame.list(cld1$Subtype))),
  dt1, by = "Subtype", all.x = TRUE
)

fit2 <- aov(PC2 ~ Subtype, data = pcoadata)
cld2 <- multcompLetters4(fit2, TukeyHSD(fit2))
dt2 <- aggregate(PC2 ~ Subtype, data = pcoadata, FUN = max)
names(dt2)[2] <- "value_max"
text2 <- merge(
  transform(as.data.frame.list(cld2$Subtype), Subtype = rownames(as.data.frame.list(cld2$Subtype))),
  dt2, by = "Subtype", all.x = TRUE
)

# ---- Boxplots ----
p2 <- ggplot(pcoadata, aes(Subtype, PC1, fill = Subtype)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5, color = "black", linetype = "dotted") +
  stat_boxplot(aes(ymin = ..lower.., ymax = ..upper..), outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", aes(ymin = ..ymax..), width = 0.2, size = 0.35) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", aes(ymax = ..ymin..), width = 0.2, size = 0.35) +
  geom_text(data = text1, aes(label = Letters, y = value_max + 0.0082),
            angle = -90, color = "black", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal2) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  coord_flip()

p3 <- ggplot(pcoadata, aes(Subtype, PC2, fill = Subtype)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5, color = "black", linetype = "dotted") +
  stat_boxplot(aes(ymin = ..lower.., ymax = ..upper..), outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", aes(ymin = ..ymax..), width = 0.2, size = 0.35) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", aes(ymax = ..ymin..), width = 0.2, size = 0.35) +
  geom_text(data = text2, aes(label = Letters, y = value_max + 0.0055),
            angle = 0, color = "black", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal2) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# ---- PERMANOVA on top-20 genes (Bray) ----
dist_mat <- vegdist(t(expr[top_genes, , drop = FALSE]), method = "bray")
otu.adonis <- adonis2(dist_mat ~ Subtype, data = pcoadata)

p4 <- ggplot() +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = 0, y = 0.1,
      label = paste(
        "PERMANOVA:",
        paste0("df = ", otu.adonis$Df[1]),
        paste0("R2 = ", round(otu.adonis$R2[1], 5)),
        paste0("p-value = ", signif(otu.adonis$`Pr(>F)`[1], 3)),
        sep = "\n"
      )
    ),
    size = 3.5, color = "black", fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# ---- Assemble like your example ----
final_plot <- p2 + p4 + plot + p3 +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 4), widths = c(4, 1), ncol = 2, nrow = 2)

# Optional save:
ggsave(paste0(out_prefix, "_PCA_panel_gender.png"), final_plot, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
# Packages
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggpubr))

# choose which PC to plot
which_pc <- "PC1"  # or "PC2"

# build data from existing objects
rt <- data.frame(
  id         = pcoadata$sample,
  Type       = factor(pcoadata$Subtype, levels = c("Female","Male")),
  Expression = pcoadata[[which_pc]]
)

# add pooled "All" to make 3 violins
rt_all <- rt; rt_all$Type <- factor("All", levels = c("Female","Male","All"))
rt3 <- rbind(
  transform(rt,   Type = factor(as.character(Type), levels = c("Female","Male","All"))),
  rt_all
)

# pairwise comparisons
group <- levels(rt3$Type)
comp  <- combn(group, 2)
my_comparisons <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(comp)), function(i) comp[, i])

# global test
kw <- compare_means(Expression ~ Type, data = rt3, method = "kruskal.test")
ylab_top <- max(rt3$Expression, na.rm = TRUE)

# plot (note: add / add.params are INSIDE ggviolin())
outFile <- paste0(out_prefix, "_violin_", which_pc, "_3groups_gender.pdf")
pdf(file = outFile, width = 6, height = 4)
p <- ggviolin(
  rt3, x = "Type", y = "Expression",
  fill = "Type",
  xlab = "Type", ylab = which_pc,
  legend.title = "Type",
  trim = FALSE,
  add = "boxplot", add.params = list(fill = "white", width = 0.15, color = "black")
) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons, method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif") +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = ylab_top,
           label = paste0("Kruskal–Wallis p = ", formatC(kw$p, format = "e", digits = 2)),
           fontface = "bold", vjust = -0.3) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "top")
print(p)
dev.off()
message("Saved: ", outFile)


```
